info.title: Google Forms Universal API
info.description: Create forms, collect responses, share surveys, and analyze results.

put.description: Adds multiple questions to a form in Google Forms.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

formId.description: The form identifier returned by Create Form.

questions[].description: Questions to add. Common fields per question: title, type (text, paragraph, choice, checkbox, dropdown, scale, date, time, rating), description, required, options, low, high, lowLabel, highLabel, includeTime, includeYear, duration, ratingScaleLevel, iconType. Advanced quiz fields: pointValue, correctAnswers.

startIndex.description: Index for the first inserted question. Later questions are inserted after it in order.

includeFormInResponse.description: Return the updated form in the response.

requiredRevisionId.description: Only apply the update if the form is still at this revision.

targetRevisionId.description: Apply this update against a recent revision and let Google transform non-conflicting changes.

items.description: Batch update replies for each created question.

requiredRevisionId.description: Revision ID for subsequent guarded writes.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

targetRevisionId.description: Optimistic write-control revision ID; Google transforms against later edits when possible.
